claims.sourceText: Blast Effects on Existing Upshot-Knothole and Teapot Structures, DTIC AD0460283, 6 May 1960, acknowledgments
claims.text: A 1960 report names 'Eric H. Wang, Chief, Structures Division' at Headquarters Research Directorate, Air Force Special Weapons Center, Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico -- establishing his move from Air Materiel Command to Kirtland and his continued leadership of a structures organisation there.

claims.sourceText: Full-text reading of DTIC ADA073468, ADA073475 and AD0460283; negative finding
claims.text: Nothing in the UPSHOT-KNOTHOLE reports or the 1960 AFSWC report touches unidentified aerial phenomena, recovered materiel, reverse engineering, Henry Kissinger or Viktor Schauberger. Wang's documented role throughout is blast effects on structures. No document supporting an Austrian birth was located.
